hypothesis: A single cart holds two lines on the same inventory item WIDGET (OVS-PIECE x6 and OVS-TWOPACK x3, i.e. 12 units against 10 stocked). The availability check in ensureInventoryLevels runs per reservation input against the same pre-batch available_quantity, so each line passes on its own and neither is summed. Completion should succeed, producing an order that needs 12 WIDGET units while only 10 were stocked, so no_oversell should fail (and reserved_matches_reservations should still pass since the counter sums the adjustments).
